sample_unit: adolescents (74 with AIS, 23 with postural asymmetry)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of general-purpose LLMs assessing scoliosis from photographs versus radiographic reference
links.effect: ChatGPT specificity 0% (95% CI 0.0-14.8), misclassifying all non-AIS cases; Claude 2 78.3% false positives; ChatGPT thoracic Cobb overestimated by +10.74° (LoA -21.45° to +42.92°).
links.quote: The LLMs exhibited hazardous diagnostic inaccuracy: ChatGPT misclassified all non-AIS cases (specificity 0% [95% CI: 0.0-14.8]), while Claude 2 generated 78.3% false positives.

screen.reason: This is a prospective diagnostic accuracy benchmark evaluating multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 2) on clinical photographs of scoliosis, evaluating AI diagnostic performance without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
